about: Each page's title, description and share image words. tools/build-page-meta.py writes them into the pages and makes the share images; tools/build-gallery.py uses the album entries. See tools/README.md ("Page titles and share images").

/.title: North Canterbury Athletic Club — Run. Jump. Throw. Walk. Belong.
/.description: A community athletics club in Rangiora for all ages and abilities: track and field, cross country, road running and coaching, from age 7 to masters.
/.headline: Run. Jump. Throw. Walk. Belong.
/.line: A Rangiora based athletics club for every age, from 7 to masters.

/calendar/.title: Club calendar: training, interclub and events
/calendar/.description: Upcoming club training, interclub, and regional and national events for North Canterbury Athletic Club, with a calendar feed you can subscribe to.
/calendar/.headline: Club calendar
/calendar/.line: Training, interclub, and regional and national events. Subscribe and it stays up to date.

/monday-training/.title: Monday running, sprint and walks training in Rangiora
/monday-training/.description: Monday running, sprint and walking sessions at Ashgrove Park, Kingsbury Ave, Rangiora. Everyone is welcome to come along and give it a try.
/monday-training/.headline: Monday training
/monday-training/.line: Running, sprints and walks at Ashgrove Park, Rangiora. Everyone welcome.

/open-day/.title: Open Day: try athletics with us
/open-day/.description: Come and try athletics with North Canterbury Athletic Club in Rangiora: sessions for children aged 7 to 14, and for high school, senior and masters athletes.
/open-day/.headline: Open Day
/open-day/.line: Come and try athletics with us, from age 7 to masters.

/club-champs/.title: Children’s club championships: points and results
/club-champs/.description: How the children’s club championships work for grades 7 to 14 at North Canterbury Athletic Club: the programme, the points, and the standings and results.
/club-champs/.headline: Children’s club championships
/club-champs/.line: Grades 7 to 14: the programme, the points, and the standings and results.

/records/.title: Children’s club records, grades 7 to 14
/records/.description: The club’s best mark in every track, field and race walking event for grades 7 to 14, linked to the official results. Filter by grade, gender and event.
/records/.headline: Children’s club records
/records/.line: The club’s best mark in every event, grades 7 to 14.

/gallery/.title: Photo gallery: club athletes in action since 2017
/gallery/.description: Photos of North Canterbury Athletic Club athletes at club nights, competitions, cross country and prizegivings since 2017, album by album.
/gallery/.headline: Photo gallery
/gallery/.line: Club athletes in action since 2017, album by album.

/history/.title: Club history since 1978
/history/.description: The story of North Canterbury Athletic Club since it was founded in Rangiora in 1978: our affiliations, club colours and notable performances.
/history/.headline: Club history
/history/.line: Founded in Rangiora in 1978: our affiliations, colours and notable performances.

/coaches-officials-volunteers/.title: Help out: coach, officiate or volunteer
/coaches-officials-volunteers/.description: The club is run by its members. How families and members can help as coaches, officials and volunteers, in roles that mostly need no experience.
/coaches-officials-volunteers/.headline: Help out
/coaches-officials-volunteers/.line: Coach, officiate or volunteer. Most roles need no experience.

/committee/.title: Club committee and annual general meeting
/committee/.description: Meet the club’s volunteer committee, elected each year at the annual general meeting, and find out how to stand, nominate someone or have your say.

/committee/.line: Run by volunteers, elected each year at the annual general meeting.

/resources/.title: Coaching and officiating resources
/resources/.description: Free guides for coaches, officials and parents: planning a session, learning an event, officiating for the first time and how things are meant to be run.
/resources/.headline: Resources
/resources/.line: Free guides for coaches, officials and parents.

/athletics-nz-library-inventory/.description: An index of every folder and file in the Athletics New Zealand eLearning library: club toolkit, coaching, officials, safeguarding and newsletters.

/athletics-nz-library-inventory/.line: Every folder and file, indexed, with a link straight to it.

/safeguarding/.description: How North Canterbury Athletic Club keeps young athletes safe: our committee’s safeguarding training, how to raise a concern, and the guidance we follow.

/safeguarding/.line: Keeping young athletes safe, and how to raise a concern.
